title: Chameleon wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <path d='M30 42 Q40 36 50 40 Q60 36 70 42' fill='none' stroke='#7FE07F' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <rect x='34' y='66' width='7' height='12' rx='3' fill='#2E9E2E'/>

  <path d='M73 26 L85 26' stroke='#FFE55A' stroke-width='3'/>
  <path d='M71.5 30 L86 30' stroke='#5AD1FF' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='8' r='3.5' fill='#FFE55A'/>
  <!-- Spots on body -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='50' r='3' fill='#7FE07F'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='48' r='3' fill='#7FE07F'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='58' r='2.5' fill='#F5E55A'/>
